title: Toyota Donates Last GR Supra MkV Final Edition to Support Reach Out WorldWide’s Disaster Relief Efforts

body_markdown:
**PLANO, Texas (Sept. 8, 2026)** **—** Toyota has donated the Toyota GR Supra MkV Final Edition to Reach Out WorldWide (ROWW), a historic gift that will help support the organization’s disaster relief mission. The one-of-one vehicle is the very last MkV GR Supra produced, a highly collectible, 382-horsepower, six-speed manual Supra featuring commemorative details and factory-exclusive specifications, underscoring Toyota’s commitment to honoring the model’s legacy while supporting a meaningful cause.


The donation represents a powerful full-circle moment for the fifth-generation Supra, building on the car’s storied history and Toyota’s long-standing support of charitable efforts. ROWW and Toyota expressed gratitude for the opportunity to use this historic vehicle to benefit communities in need and create a lasting impact through the generosity of collectors and enthusiasts.


To view the full release, please click[here](https://www.barrett-jackson.com/media/press-releases/toyota-donates-last-ever-gr-supra-mkv-final-edition-to-benefit-reach-out-worldwide-at-barrett-jackson-2027-scottsdale-auction) .
